basics.name: Tao Zhang
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at the University of Science and Technology of China working on efficient LLM inference serving, AI infrastructure, and multi-agent systems.

work.name: Cloud Security AI Capability Construction Platform Application
work.summary: Led backend architecture and code design for a cloud-security AI platform.
highlights: Designed high-throughput traffic database and traffic capture preprocessing components.
Built distributed database support for large-scale query workloads and backend APIs.
Delivered the platform to the traffic operation and maintenance system of Hefei City Cloud Data Center.

work.name: Intelligent Scientist Task Scheduling System
work.summary: Designed and implemented the task scheduling module for an intelligent scientist platform.
highlights: Modeled the scheduling problem and developed efficient scheduling algorithms.
Optimized system performance for concurrent multi-task execution and resource allocation.
Integrated the module with cross-functional teams and improved system stability.
